name: 05-absence-mid-set-pause-resume
description: Simulated, 30 fps, 1 px noise: 3 full reps, then the user disappears (joints null) while holding the bottom of a 4th rep, so that attempt is cancelled ("repCancelled lost") and the set pauses ("paused lost"); after 2 s they are back in a plank, the set resumes, and 3 more reps count (6 in total). targetReps 30.
